headline.title: In Harvard study, AI offered more accurate emergency room diagnoses than two human doctors
headline.summary: A Harvard study found that a large language model provided more accurate emergency room diagnoses than two human doctors in real cases. The research highlights the potential of AI in medical contexts, particularly in emergency situations.

articles.title: How the internet’s favorite squirrel dad made the hottest camera app of 2026
articles.summary: The DualShot Recorder app quickly became the top paid app on the App Store within 12 hours of its release, marking an unexpected success. The app's development is linked to a popular internet personality known for his squirrel-themed content.

articles.title: AI music is flooding streaming services — but who wants it?
articles.summary: AI-generated music is increasingly populating streaming services, raising questions about its reception and demand among listeners. The article explores the implications of this trend for the music industry and the evolving landscape of music consumption.

articles.title: AI-generated actors and scripts are now ineligible for Oscars
articles.summary: The Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences has announced that AI-generated actors and scripts will no longer be eligible for Oscar nominations. This decision impacts projects like Tilly Norwood, which involved AI in its creative process.

articles.title: The best AI dictation apps, tested and ranked
articles.summary: A recent evaluation of AI dictation apps highlights their effectiveness for tasks such as replying to emails, taking notes, and coding via voice commands. The article ranks the top-performing apps based on testing results.

articles.title: Disneyland Now Uses Face Recognition on Visitors
articles.summary: Disneyland has implemented facial recognition technology for visitors to enhance security and streamline entry processes. In related news, the NSA is testing Anthropic’s Mythos Preview for vulnerability assessment, and a Finnish teenager faces charges related to the Scattered Spider hacking incidents.
